screen.neoorigins.mob_creator: Te Kaihanga o te Tūturu o te Rōpū
gui.neoorigins.mob_creator.tab.spawn_rul: Ko nga Ture o te Spawn
gui.neoorigins.creator.stub: %s tab i whakatinanahia i roto i te waahanga 2.1 i muri mai
origins.neoorigins.human.name: Ko te tangata
origins.neoorigins.human.description: He tangata noa, kahore he kaha motuhake engari he kaha katoa.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Ko Merling
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: He tangata wai i whanau i roto i te moana tuwhera e manawa ana i te wai, e horoi ana me te ngawari, engari ka puhoi, ka maroke ki te whenua maroke.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: He manu
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: He kaieke ataahua e heke haere ana, e kore e wehi i te tiketike, e titiro ana ki te ao i runga.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: Te whakakii
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: I whanau mai i nga ahi o raro i whakairihia i te hupa, i whakahoutia i te ao pouri, engari i whakangarohia e te wai me te ua.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: He tohunga rere noa e rere ana i roto i te rangi, kaore i pa ki nga kaha kinetic, engari he ngoikore te anga me te kore e kaha ki te kawe i te whakangungu rakau taumaha.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderian
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: I whanau ki nga motu o waho o te Whakamutunga e tere haere ana ki te hiahia, e rere ana i nga pupuhi ki roto i te kore, e haere ana i te kore e kitea e nga tangata o te mutunga.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Ko nga ngeru ngeru
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Ko te iwi ngeru ngeru e piki ana i tetahi taiepa, e maka ana i nga whatu ki nga hoariri, e patu ana me nga ngeru ki nga kaiwhaiwhai e waru waewae o te ao
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Ko te mea nui
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: He rite tonu ki te karaehe, ka pakaru i ngā whiu, ka heke ki roto i te kōpae, ka whakarewahia e ia ngā hoariri ki te rangi, me te pupuhi o te whakairo.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Ko te wairua
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: He mea e rere ana i te po i runga i nga parirau Elytra, e kaha ana i nga patu, engari e tahuna ana e te marama o te ra, e kore e taea te okioki.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: E manawa ana i raro i te wai ki te mutunga kore, ka kite mārama i roto i te wai me te kore e haumanu.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: Ka tere ake te nekehanga i te wā e kaukau ana.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: Ka kite mārama i roto i te hohonu pouri. Whakamahia te kī Night Vision (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.merling_land_slowdown.d: E neke ana i te 10% iti ake i runga i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Ka maroke
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Ka heke te hau i te wa e kore ai koe e wai: he roa rawa te mata, a ka mate koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te manawa wai, ko te rori mahi tata rānei, e aukati ana i a koe.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: E kore e tango kino i te hinga parirau hopu i te hau.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: He Roro te Whakaheke
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: Togable: drifting puhoi ki raro. Whakakorea rite te taunoa. Tuhipoka: pānga nui e hiahia ana ki te hinga noa, na kia mau i tenei ki crit.
Ko te kai a te kaitākaro
Whakamahia 75% iti ake te pūngao i ngā mahi katoa.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Te Tirohanga Ataahua
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Ko nga kanohi whakaiti ka kite pai ake i te pouri.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Ko nga wheua o nga wheua
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 ngā ngakau (-2 HP mōrahi). tinana marama, anga ngoikore.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Te Hōputu Hōputu
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Ka peke te hau ki runga me te pupuhi tere o te parirau. Kāore he utu hiakai.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: E kore e kaha ki te ahi, te hau, te magma, me te tahu ka whakautu te ahi o roto ki te ahi o waho.
+3 ngā ngakau (+6 HP mōrahi). Ka whakapakarihia te tinana e ngā papa kirihou.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: Tere i runga i te whenua kāinga neke tere ake i roto i te Nether (ahore tohu pānga kitea).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.n: Ko nga Pukapuka o te Horoa
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Nā ngā ringa pōhēhē i taku mahi i te taumata kōhatu-piha te pakaru i te kohatu, i te kohatu, i te kōhatu, me te kōhatu kore he taputapu.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Ko te ahi o roto e tahu ana i te wera te hiakai e rere ana 25% tere ake.
Ko te wai he waipiro e 1.5 nga kino i ia tuarua i te wai, i te ua ranei.
Ko nga kanohi i whakatikatika ki te whero-kore ka kite marama i te pouri. Whakamahia te paatene Whakaaturanga Po (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Ko te ahi
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Hurihia he pōro ahi iti ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. E rua ngā pūngao, e wha ngā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Ka piki ake te tere i te wa e whakarewa ana me te elytra.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Te Rerenga Ora
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: Ka rere rite ki te kaiwhakamahi Elytra kahore he taonga e hiahiatia ana. Patohia te peke i te wa e hinga ana ki te whakamararatia o koutou parirau.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: +30% te tere rere ka piko te rangi ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Ko te Whatiwhati o te Runga
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.descri: E kore e tango i te ngaronga hinga.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Ko te ārai ki te kino o te pānga o te elytra e rere ana ki ngā pakitara me te kore e whai hua.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: He anga whakangahau
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Ko nga wheua manu pōhēhē e rua iti iho ngā ngakau mō te nui.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Kāore e taea te kawe i ngā kākahu taumaha
E kore e taea te kakahu rino, koura, taimana, ranei netherite whakangungu kiri me te mekameka anake.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Ko te taitara
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Te utu ki mua i runga i nga waewae matotoru.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Te whenua o te whenua
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Te patu i te whenua ki te patu rino 4 kino me te Slowness II mo te 4 hēkona ki nga hoariri tata katoa i roto i te irawhiti o te 5 tāone.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: E wareware ana nga tangata o raro ki to titiro, titiro ki a ratou, me te kore e whakaoho i tetahi whakaeke.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% te tūponotanga ki te whakawhiti atu, ki te karo i te kino i te wā e patua ana e te pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: E rua nga kino i ia hēkona mai i te whakapā ki te wai, ki te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Ender Warp
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Teleport ki te wahi e rapu ana koe ki runga ki te 50 tāone. utu 2 pūngao. 3 hēkona cooldown.
Kia piri ki tetahi mata poutū pēhi ki te taiepa ki te hopu, peke ki te piki, pupuri i te takahi ki te noho i te wahi. Ka ārai kino hinga i te wa e hopu ana.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Ka neke i roto i nga whatu whetu me te kore e whakamutua, ka pakaru i a raatau tata tonu.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: E kiia ana he arthropod he nui ake te kino mai i nga patu a Bane o Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.n: Ko te Ngutu o te Rangi
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Ko ngā whakaeke Melee e werohia ana te waipiro e pā ana ki te Poison I mō te 3 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Ka maka e ia he whatu karaihe e whakanohoia ana ki runga ki te pānga, e whakakotahi ana i nga mea katoa e taka ana ki runga.
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Te aukati tuuturu I te kōpaki e hopu ana i nga whiu ka pakaru i te tinana ngawari.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.nam: Ko te kohinga o nga hua
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: He tere ake i te ritenga.
E mahi ana: tukua he pupuhi o nga pupuhi levitation e rere ana nga hoariri tata ki runga mō te 3 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.nam: Ko te Whakakorenga o te Hoko
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Active: ngaro i roto i to koutou kōpae, ka puta ano ki runga ki te 12 kōpae tawhiti. utu 3 pūmau. 10 hēkona cooldown.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: He ārai ki te whakaheke ka mau tonu tō kōpae i a koe i te wā e hoki mai ana ngā pupuhi.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pouri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Kāore e hiahia ana ki te manawa, ka ora tonu i raro i te wai.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Ko te ahua o te wairua
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: E kore e kitea, e rere atu ana ki te kore taumaha.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Nga Rapa Rapa
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: Ka rere rite ki te kaiwhakamahi Elytra kahore he taonga e hiahiatia ana. Patohia te peke i te wa e hinga ana ki te whakamararatia o koutou parirau.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.na: Te Hau Hau o te Hau
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Ka piki ake te tere i te wa e whakarewa ana ki te rere ka eke te wairua ki runga i o rātau parirau.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Ko te papa o te marama
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Te aukati i raro i te marama (i te po anake) te marama marama e hipoki ana i te ahua o te ra.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Ko te Rongo o te wairua
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Whakaorangia te 1 HP ia wa e whakamatea ana e koe he mea ora.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Kaore he taumaha
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: E kore e tangohia he kino hinga tinana wairua e kore e whenua.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Te wera o te ra
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Ka pupuhi te ahi, ka ngaro te 1.5 i te rua i te marama o te ra.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: He ahua ngoikore
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 ngā ngakau (-4 HP mōrahi). He ngāwari te whakakore i tētahi tinana o te pōro.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Ko te wehi kore moe
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Kaore e taea te moe te po ko to waahanga.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Ko te ngeru
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: He tangata ngeru tere me te tirohanga o te po me te peke pukupuku ka hinga ki runga i o ratou waewae, ka rere atu ki nga kirehe me nga okelots, engari ka kino ki te wai, ka wera wawe i te kaha.
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.nam: Ko nga kanohi o te ngeru
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Ka kite mārama i te pōuri. Pāwhiritia ki te pātene Tirohanga Po (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: He ngawari
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: He tere ake te 10% i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Ko te Hauora o te Kaiwhaiwhai
